articles.title: The Polish Prosecutor's Office is investigating the attack in Krakow as a terrorist crime
articles.description: The Polish Prosecutor's Office opened an investigation this Sunday for a crime "of a terrorist nature" after this Saturday's shooting at Krakow's Market Square, which left six dead. The perpetrator of the crime, a 24-year-old Pole, is in custody and seriously wounded.

articles.title: Policeman killed in militant attack in Pakistan's restive northwest
articles.description: ISLAMABAD: A policeman was killed in a militant attack in Pakistan's northwestern Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (KP) province on Sunday, provincial authorities said, underscoring persistent security challenges in a region that has witnessed a surge in militant violence in recent years.
